description: Worked GTS ID examples drawn from template-mfe's own MFE packages (demo-mfe, _blank-mfe, widgets-fixture-a/b), for direct citation/reuse when authoring a new MFE package's mfe.json. Companion to the gts-id-conventions guideline in this same bundle.

instanceSegment.appliesTo: Every family below. The instance segment is the LAST NON-EMPTY ~-separated segment of the id: the second for mf_manifest, widget_area_extension, custom_action and the widget domain, the third for mfe_entry and screen_extension. An id ending in ~ (custom actions, fixed shared properties, fixed lifecycle actions) carries the open-reference marker after it, not a further segment.
instanceSegment.placeholders: Vendor and package are separate placeholders in every pattern below, {vendor}.{package}, so each pattern expands to exactly the five tokens of every example listed with it. There is no literal `mfe` token holding the count: demo-mfe and _blank-mfe spend their third token on `mfe`, the widget fixtures spend it on the fixture name (frontx.widgets.fixture_a.manifest.v1).
instanceSegment.failureMode: The extension still resolves - registration keys on the id verbatim, lookup keys on domain and entry, and the only id-shape gate is a prefix match on the type segment. What breaks is package attribution: extractGtsPackage takes the first two dot-tokens of the instance segment as the package id, so a segment not opening with vendor + package is filed under a wrong key in DefaultMfeRegistry.packages, and a segment ending in ~ or holding fewer than two dot-tokens makes it throw, after which the registry skips package tracking.

families.note: Never redefined; referenced verbatim by every screen entry's requiredProperties.
Never redefined; referenced verbatim by domain declarations and entry actions/domainActions.
